meta.note: All prices are ESTIMATES. Children prices apply to ages 3-13 in most cases. Family prices show 2 adults + 2 children. Always check official websites for current pricing and pre-book online to save.

attractions.name: Mary Cairncross Scenic Reserve
attractions.description: 55 hectares of subtropical rainforest with stunning views over the Glass House Mountains — elevated boardwalks, interpretive centre, cafe, and abundant birdlife. A peaceful, educational family walk through ancient forest.
attractions.note: FREE. Boardwalk is pram-friendly and wheelchair accessible. Rainforest Discovery Centre has interactive displays for kids. Cafe on-site. About 7 min drive from Maleny.

attractions.name: Maleny Botanic Gardens & Bird World
attractions.description: Privately owned 18-acre garden with nearly 300 bird species in walk-through aviaries — landscaped gardens, waterfalls, panoramic Glass House Mountain views, and hands-on bird encounters. A unique hinterland attraction.
attractions.note: Family pass (2+2) often available. Bird World aviaries are the highlight — lorikeets, macaws, and cockatoos. Allow 2-3 hours. About 10 min drive from Maleny.

attractions.name: Maleny Dairies Farm Tour
attractions.description: Family-owned working dairy farm in the rolling green hills of Maleny — meet the cows, tour the milking shed, pat farm animals, and sample fresh milk, yoghurt and flavoured milk. A hands-on farm experience kids love.
attractions.note: Tours run multiple times daily. Book ahead during school holidays. Sample tastings included. About 5 min drive from Maleny village.

attractions.name: Kondalilla Falls National Park
attractions.description: Dramatic waterfall in rainforest near Montville — walking tracks through eucalypt forest to the upper falls, rock pools for swimming, and a 4.6km circuit with valley views. One of the most popular waterfall walks on the Sunshine Coast.
attractions.note: FREE. Upper falls rock pool is great for swimming. Steep sections on the full circuit — younger families can walk to the upper falls and back (2km return). Bring swimmers and insect repellent.

attractions.name: Mount Ngungun Summit Walk
attractions.description: The most family-friendly summit in the Glass House Mountains — a 2.8km return track through open forest with spectacular 360-degree views of Mount Tibrogargan, Mount Coonowrin, and Mount Beerwah from the top. An achievable family challenge.
attractions.note: FREE. Allow 45-60 min up. Some rocky sections — proper shoes essential. No toilets at the trailhead. Best done early morning. About 20 min from Beerwah.

attractions.name: Glass House Mountains Lookout
attractions.description: Breathtaking panoramic viewpoint overlooking the entire Glass House Mountains range — picnic areas, BBQ facilities, and a short forest ramble. No climbing required for incredible views stretching to Moreton Bay.
attractions.note: FREE. Perfect for a picnic with a view. BBQ and toilet facilities. Short accessible walk from car park. Combine with Mount Ngungun walk for a full morning.

attractions.name: Gardners Falls
attractions.description: Beautiful waterfall and swimming hole on Obi Obi Creek near Maleny — a short easy walk to cascades, a natural rock pool, and a rope swing. Shaded by rainforest, free, and perfect for a hot hinterland day.
attractions.note: FREE. Short 500m walk from car park. Rocks can be slippery — water shoes recommended. Popular in summer — arrive early. About 10 min drive from Maleny.

attractions.name: Mapleton Falls National Park
attractions.description: Stunning 120m waterfall plunging into the valley below — wheelchair-accessible lookout, short rainforest walks, and incredible views over the Obi Obi Valley. A peaceful hinterland gem with minimal walking required.
attractions.note: FREE. Lookout is wheelchair accessible. Wompoo circuit walk (1.3km) for those wanting a short stroll. Picnic tables available. Right next to Mapleton village.

attractions.name: Montville Village & Gallery Walk
attractions.description: Charming mountain village shopping strip — artisan galleries, handmade craft stores, fudge shops, German cuckoo-clock store, boutique clothing, and scenic lookouts. Cool mountain air and a relaxed village atmosphere.
attractions.note: FREE to wander. Parking can be tight on weekends — arrive before 10am. Combine with The Edge Restaurant for lunch or Kondalilla Falls for the afternoon.

attractions.name: Baroon Pocket Dam
attractions.description: Picturesque reservoir between Montville and Maleny — BBQ areas, picnic spots, walking tracks, and kayak hire on weekends. Stunning reflections of the surrounding hills in the still water. A local favourite for relaxed family outings.
attractions.note: FREE. Kayak hire available weekends and school holidays. Great for a picnic lunch. Part of the Sunshine Coast Hinterland Great Walk. About 15 min from Montville.

attractions.name: Mount Beerwah Base & Viewpoint Walk
attractions.description: Easy 1km walk through eucalypt forest around the base of Mount Beerwah — the tallest of the Glass House Mountains at 556m. Stunning viewpoints of the mountain's dramatic volcanic face, no technical climbing needed.
attractions.note: FREE. Flat and easy — suitable for prams and young children. The summit route is for experienced climbers only. Interpretive signs explain Aboriginal significance. About 25 min from Beerwah.

attractions.name: Maleny Cheese Factory
attractions.description: Artisan cheese factory and cafe in Maleny — watch cheese being made through viewing windows, sample handcrafted cheeses, enjoy a cheese platter or light lunch. A delicious stop for food-loving families exploring the hinterland.
attractions.note: FREE entry. Cheese tastings and platters are paid. Great combined with Maleny Dairies for a hinterland food trail day. Walking distance from Maleny village.
